datasets.name: Historical landslide dataset of western Sichuan region
datasets.source: Authors' own construction using Google Earth imagery
datasets.verbatim: This study focuses on the western Sichuan region and constructs a historical landslide dataset using Google Earth imagery, which includes 4280 landslide samples (3424 for training and 856 for validation).

methods.name: YOLO-EfficientNetV2
methods.summary: An object detection model based on YOLOv10-n, modified by replacing the backbone with EfficientNetV2 (incorporating FusedMBConv and MBConv), integrating the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM), and retaining the v10Detect head for NMS-free inference.
methods.source: Yuyang Song, Lina Hao, Weile Li
methods.verbatim: The source codes are available for downloading at the link: https://github.com/syy621/YOLOv10-efficientv2.

code_links.name: YOLO-EfficientNetV2
code_links.summary: Custom code combining YOLO-based detection with an EfficientNetV2 backbone, implemented in Python and shared via GitHub.

availability.author_statement: "Data will be made available on request."

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory was constructed by the authors but is not referenced or linked. The custom code is available via a provided GitHub repository link.
